title: iPhone held by iphone-runner, unused for 6 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
iphone-runner has held the iPhone lease for 6 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 22:27Z, last phone run of iphone-runner). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: double-drive-fix (owner lead; its note names the phone).
iphone-runner: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner iphone-runner) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).

Lead: false alarm, no action for iphone-runner. The only phone waiter was my own double-drive-fix row, which waits on this same P-118 block; I set it to measuring. Keep the lease between H1 and H2 (marked --between). Rule gap goes to mgmt-devices as an incident.
